data.fund_type: An open ended scheme replicating / tracking Gold
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the fund is to endeavour to provide returns that, before expenses, closely track the performance and yield of Gold. However, the performance of the scheme may differ from that of the underlying asset due to tracking error. There can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the UTI Gold ETF will be achieved.
